data.name: AutoHideSonsHotbar
data.shortDescription: Allows you to chose when to hide SonsHotbar
data.description:
Features:
- Toggle to Show/Hide SonsHotbar. (Default Hotkey: H)
- Auto Hide SonsHotbar If ALL GUI in the settings menu is Off.
- Auto Hide SonsHotbar when grab bag is opened (Interaction where you can put items to cook, store items in shelves , hang food to dry or give items to someone).
- Auto Hide SonsHotbar when playing on Zombie Mode.

Note: 
The mod obviously requires [SonsHotbar](https://sotf-mods.com/mods/aedev/sonshotbar) to work.
